entities.name: Aggressor
entities.description: A giant fluffy cat, guardian of the Gods' Hall of Starnheim and effectively a pet of the Valkyries.

entities.name: Starnheim
entities.description: Realm where Aggressor guards the Gods' Hall.

entities.name: Valkyries
entities.description: Winged beings of Starnheim whom Aggressor lives among.

entities.name: Niko Aris
entities.description: Character guided by Aggressor to the Valkyries to warn of Koma.

entities.name: Koma
entities.description: The Cosmos Serpent whose threat Niko warned the Valkyries about.

events.summary: Aggressor leads Niko through the feast crowd into a quieter hall and to the Valkyries.
events.quote: showing an interest in Niko Aris as he led them through the crowd and into a quieter hall

events.summary: Koma arrives terrifyingly at the gathering, confirming Niko's warnings; Aggressor flees to the rafters.
events.quote: Aggressor ran off to shelter in the rafters upon Koma's appearance.

relations.quote: effectively a pet of the Valkyries
Aggressor played a role in guiding Niko through the feast and into the presence of the Valkyries.
